title: FUDCourt event envelope
description: The canonical envelope for every domain event FUDCourt emits. event_type is the STABLE id from contracts/events/events.json (PascalCase); legacy SCREAMING_SNAKE names appear only as aliases. event_version is a positive integer; consumers must tolerate additive evolution within the same version (unknown payload keys are allowed and must be ignored). Events never carry credentials or secrets.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event instance.

event_type.description: Stable PascalCase event id from events/catalog.json (e.g. `ExecutionCreated`). Legacy SCREAMING_SNAKE names (e.g. `EXECUTION_CREATED`) are accepted aliases of the same id.

event_version.description: Semver-ish integer version of the event shape. Starts at 1; additive changes keep the version, breaking changes bump it.

occurred_at.description: Unix milliseconds when the event occurred.

request_id.description: Correlation id of the originating request, when known.

actor_id.description: Id of the acting user or service, when known.

resource_id.description: Primary resource this event is about (execution id, account id, ...).

payload.description: Event-specific data. Free-form: additive keys may appear in any version. Never contains credentials or secrets.
